notes.title: SISYPHE 1.01 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello! Thank you for playing SISYPHE, it warms my heart receiving such a positive reception to the game.  Here's the short patch notes for 1.01:

- Fixed an issue where the player could not move after continuing a save.

Thank you and have a nice weekend!

notes.title: SISYPHE has gone gold! The Game is releasing March 21st!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119022/f2fc8fe0123d3c7361516e5b71fb31e552abcc1f.png[/img]

[b]SISYPHE has gone gold![/b] This means all content in the game is [b]finished[/b] and ready for release, all that's left is some [b]minor bug fixes and playtesting![/b]

[i]Thank you everyone who has wishlisted, played the demo, or just thought about the game once, your support is what keeps me going in this.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119022/911129ca019d30111543cd9ce572b3de592e29b7.gif[/img]

[b]SISYPHE will be releasing on March 21st[/b], with a [b]standard game version[/b] and a [b]bundle[/b] with the game and the OST. The soundtrack is also available to purchase standalone on the same date and will feature 7 songs from the game, along with 3 bonus tracks produced by [b]Lucas Ljunggren[/b]!

Also, would you like to playtest the game before release? Contact me on Discord (Discord: zuperlucaz), or send me an email (Email: SISYPHEgame@outlook.com) and you might hear back from me! Good Luck!

[b]I hope you all look forward to the release and I wish you all the best until then![/b]

Thank you!
Lucas Ljunggren - Developer of SISYPHE.
